Job Summary

• Monitor and coordinate electrician daily activities to ensure electric works are performed in a technically correct and efficient manner, conform to company's standard and policies.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Responsible for compliance to weekly and monthly planning, including schedule work order, relating to all maintenance tasks set out daily / to help achieve long term maintenance plans and high equipment availability.
Long term maintenance plans and high equipment availability are successfully achieved.

Prepare and submit relevant reporting tasks required in a timely manner, example; review and ensure correct details on work orders and regularly submit to planners for closing, ensure backlog parts are ordered, vendor time sheets and job cards are accurate.
Work orders details are accurate and backlog parts are successfully ordered.

Supervise auto electrical foremen activities to ensure work is mechanically correct and performed in a safe and cost effective manner.
Electrical foremen working activities are mechanically correct and performed in a safe and cost effective manner.

Responsible in maintaining and repairing Electrician system in site / project.
Electrician systems in site / project are well-maintained and successfully repaired.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

High School Graduate of Engineering

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Diploma with 1 year experiences in engineering (electrical).
• Good understanding of electrical equipment, any cable size and wires commonly used in electrical installing.
• Good understanding of electric installation.
• Understanding of business line requirements and production targets.
• Understanding of equipment availability and planning of repairs.
• Commitment and good communication and supervisory skill.
• Fluent in English, both
spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Melakukan tugas dan operasi gudang.

- Melakukan tugas bongkar muat barang gudang
- Menangani pemeliharaan dan perbaikan peralatan gudang.
- Memecahkan dan menyelesaikan masalah operasional.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar gudang dan protokol keselamatan.
- Memelihara catatan gudang yang akurat dan terkini.

Company:
SHP PT. Sanghiang Perkasa
